title: RTEC ADA complaint process — historical source version
summary: Organization-level ADA complaint procedure found in the compliance archive. It defines intake channels, a five-calendar-day filing rule, coordinator contact, investigation timing, response, appeal and closure logic. Currentness has not yet been established.

claims.claim: The source allows an ADA complaint by form, phone, representative, or RTEC staff assistance when the complainant cannot write.
The source states complaints must be filed within five calendar days of the alleged incident.

evidence.note: Historical source; current legal/process validity must be revalidated before operational use.

claims.claim: The historical workflow specifies coordinator contact within 10 business days, investigation initiation within 15 business days when applicable, completion within 60 calendar days, and a five-business-day appeal window after RTEC's response.

trigger: Allegation of disability discrimination involving RTEC service, vehicles or facilities.
steps: ADA Coordinator contacts complainant and requests needed information.
Determine whether allegation falls within ADA complaint process.
Complete investigation or notify complainant if additional time is needed.
Allow appeal within source-defined window; close when final.
decisions: Whether requested information was provided in the required timeframe.
deadlines: Complaint filing: 5 calendar days from alleged incident in this source.
Investigation start: within 15 business days if applicable.
Appeal: within 5 business days of response.
exceptions: Complaint may be closed if required information is not supplied in the source-defined timeframe.
unresolved_questions: What date/version is this ADA complaint process?
Does the current ADA process still use the five-calendar-day filing requirement and these deadlines?
Who is the current ADA Coordinator and where is the current complaint log/form maintained?
automation_candidates: Restricted ADA complaint case workflow with deadline tracking and accessibility accommodations.
Version-aware form/process publishing so outdated complaint deadlines are not used.

provenance.notes: Found in !Compliance.zip under TITLE VI LEP PLAN/ADA.
